about: Interface translations for hi. Fill every "t" (leave the other fields: they are reference only). Exact keys: the English UI string -> your text. Patterns: the template -> your text with {1}..{k} standing for the slots in template order (reorder freely; every slot must appear). Slot types: n = integer count; f = decimal number; s = short text (lazy match), e.g. a deck or lesson name; x = free text (greedy match); e = e-mail address; d = text without "·", e.g. a deck name inside a "·"-separated line. Follow docs/profiles/hi.md for register and glossary. Then: python3 tools/i18n/gen.py hi && node tools/i18n/validate.js hi
